decision.model: One immutable run value; pure advance(run,event) returns state and explicit effects. Scheduling and reports derive from accepted execution records.
decision.scheduling: Ready workers pull one eligible test at a time; preserve global discovery/focus/filter/skip decisions and existing stable IDs.
decision.browser: One owned Playwright Core browser server with a bounded pool of isolated worker contexts. Test callbacks and Interactor stay browser-local.
decision.resources: Project owns independent app/database/queue/provider/storage resources. Declare browser-wide resources before dispatch and reserve all required resources together through execution shutdown, project drain and canonical acceptance.

randomization.replay: Record actual queues; seed determines priority, not completion-dependent assignments or app/network interleaving.

decision.cleanupFailure: Stop admission and fail run as infrastructure failure. Preserve accepted test/hook outcomes; never silently retry/restart.
decision.strongestAlternative: Private browsers with ordinary contexts passed complete Vizzly runs at 212.17s/1worker,127.77s/4declared,89.84s/4seeded. Greater process memory and slower observed samples than shared4contexts/60.15s; not proof of a causal browser-sharing percentage.
requiredBeforeShipping: Complete Vizzly job/async-listener/transaction draining before fixture reset.
